prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tileable square grass texture for a polished cozy 2.5D survival village browser game. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; do not reproduce its UI, trees, characters, pond, paths, shadows, or buildings. Create one square 1024x1024 seamless repeatable grass-ground tile viewed straight from above, flat lighting and no perspective. Match the reference meadow's warm luminous yellow-green grassy palette, softly mottled brushed patches, very fine dense tiny grass speckles and sparse tiny blade tufts. Only a few tiny white daisies and tiny yellow flowers, very sparse and small relative to whole tile. Appealing hand-painted cartoon game art, subtly varied natural surface, rich but not dark, enough quiet open ground to support scenery sprites. Uniform distribution and color across all edges so the square tiles seamlessly in both axes. No foreground objects, no big plants, no trees, no rocks, no dirt, no paths, no edge vignette, no borders, no writing, no characters, no interface, no cast shadows. Entire square is opaque grass.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a polished cozy 2.5D survival village game. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate a transparent PNG sprite sheet, landscape 4:3 aspect ratio, exactly 2048x1536 pixels if possible and at least 1536x1152. Layout is EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows = 12 isolated sprites. Every cell is exactly one quarter of total width by one third of total height. No visible grid. Center each sprite in its own cell with at least 15 percent transparent gutters, absolutely no sprite crossing its cell border. All 12 complete objects fully visible, consistent approximately 45-degree front-overhead orthographic camera, sunlight from upper left. Match reference charming highly polished hand-painted game sprite style: rounded scalloped leaf clusters, nuanced warm highlights, dark blue-green outlines, clear chunky silhouettes, soft volume, detailed wood grain. Ordered cells, left to right: ROW 1: (1) large lush deciduous tree, three rounded clustered canopies, warm brown forked trunk; (2) alternate compact deciduous tree with similar foliage, slightly taller oval silhouette; (3) broad bushy deciduous tree with four leafy lobes and visible brown trunk; (4) round green berry bush with small bright red berries and tiny trunk. ROW 2: (1) irregular gray faceted granite boulder; (2) short cut tree stump with visible tan growth rings and bark; (3) freestanding wooden village bulletin board on two legs with small dark teal-blue roof and a few blank pale paper notes; (4) simple wooden workbench with hammer and small blue-gray tools on top. ROW 3: (1) small cozy cream-plaster wooden cottage with deep blue tiled roof, visible complete front door and two windows, little porch and steps, centered and fully contained in one cell; (2) small oval turquoise lily pond ringed with gray stones and two lily pads, fully contained in one cell; (3) resource icon of two short warm brown cut logs with pale circular ends; (4) resource icon of three shiny red berries and small green leaves. Each sprite is self contained and isolated on genuine alpha transparency. No ground patches, no background, no labels, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no user interface, no characters, no large cast shadows. Atlas composition is critical: exactly twelve cells, 4 columns by 3 rows, equal cell sizing, ordered as specified. Do not merge cells or make a scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready transparent character sprite atlas for a cozy 2.5D survival village game. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create one landscape 2:1 aspect PNG 2048x1024 if possible, EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows = eight isolated full-body character sprites. Every cell is one quarter total width by one half total height. Transparent padding generously on all sides, no visible grid. Consistent character height, scale, lighting, pose and 45 degree overhead orthographic camera matching reference. Chibi villagers with oversized rounded head, tiny oval body, little arms/hands/feet, dark blue-green clean outlines, warm softly painted volume, charming polished hand-painted 2.5D game art. ROW 1 is same villager in four directions: front facing viewer, right facing, back facing away, left facing. This villager has fluffy creamy-white hair, warm skin, brown tunic with a pale collar and dark pants, tiny leather boots, small brown backpack visible in rear and side directions. ROW 2 is a second consistent villager in same four directions: front facing viewer, right facing, back facing away, left facing. Second villager has thick navy-blue hair, orange tunic with pale collar, dark pants, tiny leather boots, small brown backpack. Facing direction must be clear, simple small expressive face on front and visible profiles, no face on rear view. Each sprite centered within its own equal cell, complete body visible, feet consistently positioned, no overlap. Genuinely transparent background, no scenery, no ground tile, no baked shadows, no text, no labels, no arrows, no extra characters. Keep the reference's compact proportions and artistic style; they should read like sprite assets from the same game.
